items.name: Screws
items.obtainment: Survivor objectives, stuns, heals, chases, escapes; killer spikes and kills
items.mainUse: Killers, Items, Emotes, and perk upgrades
items.rewardRate: Varies by action; generators 1/sec, chase 2/sec capped at 202, escape about 200, spike about 50, kill about 100
items.cardSummary: Screws are the main currency for normal progression in Violence District. They matter first because they pay for killers, survivor items, emotes, and perk upgrades.
items.imageStatus: downloaded Fandom static image as WebP

items.name: Emblems
items.cardSummary: Emblems are the rarer regular currency. They are best treated as a separate shop resource for perks, emotes, and skins instead of the main grind currency.
items.imageStatus: downloaded Fandom static image as WebP

items.name: Candies
items.obtainment: Destroy pumpkins on maps as Survivor during the Halloween event
items.cardSummary: Candies are the Halloween event currency. They belong on the currency list so old Halloween Shop rewards make sense, but they are not a normal farming target right now.
items.imageStatus: downloaded Fandom static image as WebP

items.name: Ornaments
items.source: Christmas event gifts and Robux Shop
items.obtainment: Deliver gifts to the Christmas tree during the Christmas event; killers could hit gift-carrying survivors for a reward
items.mainUse: Killer Skins, Emotes, and Item Skins
items.rewardRate: 5 Ornaments per gift; 15 during the last event week
items.cardSummary: Ornaments are the Christmas event currency. Their route is tied to gift delivery and event shop rewards, so they should be read as unavailable unless the Christmas event returns.
items.imageStatus: downloaded Fandom static image as WebP
